# Kyle Wu

Kyle Wu (Ping-Ju Wu, 吳秉儒) is a Taiwan-based FinTech builder working across product strategy, market analysis, digital finance, AI-native software execution, and independent digital publishing.

He is an incoming MSc Financial Technology student at Warwick Business School. His public work includes trading workflow automation, prediction-market execution research, and Readude, an independent digital publishing product.
